zhx_qn_calc_net = {
    variable_arithmetic_trigger = {
        export_to_variable = { variable_name = zhx_qn_round_direction value = trigger_value:num_of_cities }
        export_to_variable = { variable_name = zhx_qn_ui_value value = trigger_value:num_of_cities }
        export_to_variable = { variable_name = zhx_qn_opinion value = opinion with = event_target:zhx_tianzi }
        divide_variable = { which = zhx_qn_opinion value = 5 }
        export_to_variable = { variable_name = zhx_qn_trust value = trust with = event_target:zhx_tianzi }
        subtract_variable = { which = zhx_qn_trust value = 50 }
        divide_variable = { which = zhx_qn_trust value = 2 }
        set_variable = { which = zhx_qn_round_direction which = zhx_qn_opinion }
        multiply_variable = { which = zhx_qn_round_direction value = -1 }
        round_variable = { which = zhx_qn_opinion which = zhx_qn_round_direction }
        set_variable = { which = zhx_qn_round_direction which = zhx_qn_trust }
        multiply_variable = { which = zhx_qn_round_direction value = -1 }
        round_variable = { which = zhx_qn_trust which = zhx_qn_round_direction }
        set_variable = { which = zhx_qn_ui_value value = $offset$ }
        change_variable = { which = zhx_qn_ui_value which = zhx_qn_opinion }
        change_variable = { which = zhx_qn_ui_value which = zhx_qn_trust }
        multiply_variable = { which = zhx_qn_ui_value value = $sign$ }
        divide_variable = { which = zhx_qn_ui_value value = $divisor$ }
        round_variable = { which = zhx_qn_ui_value value = -1 }
        modulo_variable = { which = zhx_qn_ui_value value = $modulus$ }
        check_variable = { which = zhx_qn_ui_value value = $threshold$ }
    }
}

        export_to_variable = { variable_name = zhx_qn_ui_value value = trigger_value:num_of_cities }
        export_to_variable = { variable_name = zhx_qn_opinion value = opinion with = event_target:zhx_tianzi }
        divide_variable = { which = zhx_qn_opinion value = 5 }
        export_to_variable = { variable_name = zhx_qn_trust value = trust with = event_target:zhx_tianzi }
        subtract_variable = { which = zhx_qn_trust value = 50 }
        divide_variable = { which = zhx_qn_trust value = 2 }
        set_variable = { which = zhx_qn_round_direction which = zhx_qn_opinion }
        multiply_variable = { which = zhx_qn_round_direction value = -1 }
        round_variable = { which = zhx_qn_opinion which = zhx_qn_round_direction }
        set_variable = { which = zhx_qn_round_direction which = zhx_qn_trust }
        multiply_variable = { which = zhx_qn_round_direction value = -1 }
        round_variable = { which = zhx_qn_trust which = zhx_qn_round_direction }
        set_variable = { which = zhx_qn_ui_value value = $offset$ }
        change_variable = { which = zhx_qn_ui_value which = zhx_qn_opinion }
        change_variable = { which = zhx_qn_ui_value which = zhx_qn_trust }
        divide_variable = { which = zhx_qn_ui_value value = $divisor$ }
        round_variable = { which = zhx_qn_ui_value value = -1 }
        modulo_variable = { which = zhx_qn_ui_value value = $modulus$ }
        check_variable = { which = zhx_qn_ui_value value = $threshold$ }
    }
}

zhx_qn_ui_opinion_nonnegative = {
    variable_arithmetic_trigger = {
        export_to_variable = { variable_name = zhx_qn_round_direction value = trigger_value:num_of_cities }
        export_to_variable = { variable_name = zhx_qn_ui_value value = trigger_value:num_of_cities }
        export_to_variable = { variable_name = zhx_qn_opinion value = opinion with = event_target:zhx_tianzi }
        divide_variable = { which = zhx_qn_opinion value = 5 }
        export_to_variable = { variable_name = zhx_qn_trust value = trust with = event_target:zhx_tianzi }
        subtract_variable = { which = zhx_qn_trust value = 50 }
        divide_variable = { which = zhx_qn_trust value = 2 }
        set_variable = { which = zhx_qn_round_direction which = zhx_qn_opinion }
        multiply_variable = { which = zhx_qn_round_direction value = -1 }
        round_variable = { which = zhx_qn_opinion which = zhx_qn_round_direction }
        set_variable = { which = zhx_qn_round_direction which = zhx_qn_trust }
        multiply_variable = { which = zhx_qn_round_direction value = -1 }
        round_variable = { which = zhx_qn_trust which = zhx_qn_round_direction }
        set_variable = { which = zhx_qn_ui_value which = zhx_qn_opinion }
        check_variable = { which = zhx_qn_ui_value value = 0 }
    }
}
